title: Modular @gi/* Workspace Package Architecture
summary: Reorganized shared detection, scanner, artifact-panel, and utility libraries into dedicated @gi/* workspace packages, with updated application imports and package-level TypeScript configuration.

changes.text: Modular Workspace Packages: extracted detection, grid detection, image scanning, artifact panels, video scanning, scanner, and shared utility libraries into dedicated @gi/* packages.
Updated Package Integration: configured pnpm workspace resolution, Next.js package transpilation, and TypeScript path aliases, and updated application imports to use the new packages.
Removed duplicate legacy implementations and unused dependencies while retaining thin compatibility re-exports for existing src/lib import paths.
